paragraphs: I’m an AI Engineer based in Delhi, India, working across agentic AI and GenAI. I build multi-agent systems and automations: agents that plan, call tools, share context and hand work to each other, built to hold up outside a demo.

Most recently I was an AI Engineer Intern at Wobot, where I built n8n automations for internal needs, including a call recording and data extraction pipeline in which three agents work hand in hand for context retention and recall reduction. Before that, at RegalRinse, I distilled Qwen-Image-Edit into a Stable Diffusion 1.5 + LoRA student model.

I work with LangGraph, CrewAI, LangChain, MCP and n8n, with FastAPI, Celery and Redis underneath. I care less about chatbots and more about agents that reason, recover from failure and return structured outputs other systems can rely on. Open to AI engineering roles where I can keep shipping.

notes.title: RegalRinse internship details
notes.text:
AI/ML Engineer Intern at RegalRinse, Nov 2025 – Jan 2026, remote.

Engineered a teacher–student distillation pipeline transferring Qwen-Image-Edit reasoning into a Stable Diffusion 1.5 + LoRA adapter for text-controlled wall restoration and recoloring.

Built a synthetic data factory using a 4-bit quantized teacher model, with 10x lower latency and 75% VRAM reduction (16GB to 4GB), enabling free-tier GPU deployment.

Developed a regression-based pricing model estimating house construction costs across structural and material configurations.

notes.title: ResearchSynth details
notes.text:
ResearchSynth (Apr 2026). Autonomous multi-agent research platform built with LangGraph: Search, Translation and Synthesis agents produce structured markdown research reports with citations.

Async distributed backend with FastAPI, Celery, Redis, async SQLAlchemy and PostgreSQL for scalable job execution and persistent history.

LangSmith observability for token usage, cost, latency and agent reasoning. Google OAuth + JWT authentication and cross-lingual research support.

notes.title: Smart Finance AI details
notes.text:
Smart Finance AI (Feb 2026). Multi-server MCP platform with isolated microservices for financial math (SIP, EMI, CAGR, Monte Carlo), investment simulation, expense analysis and inline Base64 chart generation.

FastAPI + LangChain orchestrator with session memory, intelligent tool routing and real-time SSE token streaming for a ChatGPT-style UX.

Production patterns: API key isolation, token trimming, tool caching, structured SSE error events, and multi-session support without a persistent database.

notes.title: CodeLens details
notes.text:
CodeLens (Mar 2026). 6-agent CrewAI code review system: bug detection, security analysis, performance optimization, best practices, automated fixing and architectural review.

GitHub OAuth and GitHub API workflows fork repositories, push corrected files and open pull requests autonomously; LangSmith for full tracing.

Dockerized distributed architecture with FastAPI, Celery, Redis and React/Nginx with asynchronous status polling. Snippet reviews finish in under 60 seconds, full repositories in 3–10 minutes.
